build_note: coq/*.v compiled sequentially (one coqc at a time, no make -j), in dependency order matching upstream's own scripts/check_assumptions.sh: IDM_KeystoneKernel.v, Examples.v, ReaderTwoLevels.v, CheckAssumptions.v. All 4 compiled cleanly with `coqc -q`. No -Q logical qualification is used anywhere in these files (every Require Import is unqualified, e.g. `Require Import IDM_KeystoneKernel.`), so no _CoqProject/Makefile was needed on the Toledo side -- coqc's default current-directory module search resolves each dependency once its .vo exists from the prior sequential step, exactly mirroring how upstream's own scripts/check_assumptions.sh runs coqc directly (no coq_makefile step) against these same 4 files in this same order. Upstream's own coq/_CoqProject (a bare file list, no -Q flag, present at the source repo root) and scripts/check_repo.sh/check_assumptions.sh were read to confirm the build order and the forbidden-Axiom/Admitted repo-wide grep upstream itself runs (re-confirmed independently here: `grep -RInE '^[[:space:]]*(Axiom|Axioms|Parameter|Parameters|Conjecture|Conjectures|Admitted|admit)' coq/*.v` on the copied tree returns no match) -- neither script itself was copied into Toledo (out of the manifest's declared file scope), only followed as build-order evidence.
